entries.14ca5d692d627c96: It has long-established brand products such as Aji Shio Koshō, Hiden Yakiniku no Tare and Hakata Motsunabe Sūpu. In nabe soups, it continuously launches new planned products, such as series supervised by popular YouTubers and famous restaurants, and combines them with promotions such as campaigns and CM to win support. In manufacturing, it produces in line with food safety standards such as FSSC22000.

As of March 31, 2026, the major shareholders are Yūgen Kaisha Yamada Kōsan, holding 25.30% of issued shares (excluding treasury shares), and Ippan Zaidan Hōjin Kanazawa Kinen Ikuei Zaidan, holding 15.41%.
entries.1c6ce957800722f6: Business users such as meat processors and prepared food makers
entries.20358d9fdddc2b28: The breakdown of revenue of ¥27,489 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥20,878 million for the liquid seasonings group, ¥4,352 million for the powdered seasonings group, and ¥2,258 million for the other seasonings group. The liquid seasonings group accounted for about 3/4 of the total, and growth in yakiniku tare sauce and nabe soups drove the revenue increase. Expansion of the Kanto plant has increased production capacity, centered on nabe soups.

entries.2f2097af01da6369: This is a product group of liquid seasonings such as sauces for grilled meat and soup bases for nabe (hot pot) dishes. For retail, the main products are "Hiden Yakiniku no Tare" (secret-recipe grilled meat sauce), the "Yakiniku Dori" series, nabe soup bases supervised by popular YouTubers and famous restaurants, and "Hakata Motsu-nabe Soup"; for business use, it offers oil sauces for meat processors and sauces for prepared foods. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥20,878 million.

entries.8c22a3424372950a: This is a seasoning manufacturer headquartered in Sumida-ku, Tokyo and in Higashi-ku, Fukuoka City. It is a single-segment company engaged solely in the food business, whose main products are liquid seasonings such as sauces for grilled meat and soup bases, and seasoned salt, and it has no affiliated companies. Number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 691. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.a8855001161949d1: Under its corporate philosophy of “Creating happiness with deliciousness,” and placing safety and security first, it states that it works to create deliciousness and enjoyment in dining situations through products centered on high-quality blended seasonings. Its new medium-term management plan for fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027 takes “Challenge 2028 ～Toward a Company the World Can Be Proud Of～” as its theme and pursues the vision of “Bringing Plus to the World with ‘Fun Flavors.’” It sets out investing management resources in major urban areas in Japan to expand market share, increasing production capacity through the expansion of the Kanto plant, and continuing investment in overseas markets.
